relationships.subject: cannabinol
relationships.evidence_quote: For pro-inflammatory interleukin IL-6, at a concentration of 5 μM, CBN and CBN-11-OH show a reduction in IL-6 levels.

key_findings: CBN-11-OH is the dominant CYP-generated CBN metabolite; CBN-1'-OH is a partial CB1 agonist while CBN and metabolites antagonize CB1/CB2.
CBN and CBN-11-OH raise intracellular Ca2+ in DRG neurons.
